Description: Glyphic Biotechnologies is a research and development biotechnology firm focused on innovative protein sequencing technologies. Our operations primarily consist of the development of a massively parallel protein sequencing platform. This unique technology aims to surpass traditional protein sequencing methods, enabling the identification of proteins at minimal concentrations. To achieve this goal, we employ scientists, engineers and operators and facilitate the execution of cutting-edge R&D in chemistry, surface engineering, antibody development, and molecular biology. We have comprehensive measures in place to comply with all city, state, and federal regulations regarding research conditions, waste disposal, and tracking of hazardous materials. Our presence in Berkeley is set to enhance the city's reputation as a center for scientific innovation and provides local job opportunities in the technical and scientific sectors.
